skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the organization of customs worldwide and the development of Vietnamese customs.

Gain knowledge on state management in customs, customs agents, electronic customs, origin of goods, rules on origin of goods, inspection of origin of imported and exported goods in Vietnam, and protection of intellectual property rights at customs offices.

Learn about tax issues and tax administration for imported and exported goods in the economy, including tariffs, the role of tariffs, and Vietnam's tariff agreements under international economic integration conditions.
